Exchange/platform: Gate
Headline: Gate App Welcome Rewards: Download the App to Unlock 1 GT
Prize pool: 1 GT
Start: 2026-11-20T06:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-04T06:00:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 50 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 10 USDT (buy)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Take your first step with Gate.
Sign up on the web and register for the event to claim a 50 USDT Position Voucher. After downloading and logging in to Gate App for the first time, complete the deposit, futures, CFD, and Convert tasks to unlock a one-time reward of 1 GT in spot tokens. Rewards are credited automatically and are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Sign up now to get started.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 20, 2026, 06:00 – December 4, 2026, 06:00 (UTC)
## How to Participate
Step 1: Select [Download App to Join], sign up on the web, and complete registration
Step 2: Complete all tasks to unlock the corresponding rewards
Step 3: New users can visit Rewards Hub to unlock more exclusive bonus rewards for new users
New users who register during the event can claim one 50 USDT Position Voucher. Only 5,000 vouchers are available. Trade at least 5,000 USDT to unlock the voucher for use. First come, first served, while supplies last.
## New User App Tasks: Unlock 1 GT in Five Steps
During the event, new users who complete all five tasks below will unlock a one-time reward of 1 GT in spot tokens. A total of 3,000 rewards are available and will be credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis.
Task | Requirements | Reward
Download and Log In | Download the Gate App and log in for the first time | 0.2 GT
First Deposit | Make your first deposit of at least 50 USDT and maintain it for 24 hours | 0.2 GT
First Futures Trade | Complete your first futures trade with a volume of at least 200 USDT | 0.2 GT
First CFD Trade | Complete your first CFD trade with a volume of at least 500 USDT | 0.2 GT
First Convert Transaction | Complete your first Convert transaction worth at least 10 USDT | 0.2 GT
## Important Notes
All participants must select [Join Now] to register. Complete Identity Verification before registering for the event. Due to local policies and the platform's service coverage, registration and participation are currently unavailable in some regions.
This event is open only to new users of main accounts who register and sign up through the event page. At the time of registration, users must never have downloaded and logged in to the Gate App or completed their first Deposit, first futures trade, first CFD trade, or first Convert trade. Subaccounts are not eligible to participate.
This event's rewards are divided into registration benefits and task rewards: registration benefits are distributed as Position Vouchers, with a total of 5,000 vouchers. The reward will be credited automatically after users complete registration. Task rewards are distributed as GT Spot tokens, with a total of 3,000 tokens. Users must complete all specified tasks before they can claim the rewards in a single payment. Completing an individual task only updates task progress and does not trigger a separate reward. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. If a reward is not credited, the corresponding reward may have already been fully distributed, or the user may not meet the task participation requirements.
Trading volume from USD1 futures pairs does not count toward event tasks.
After users select [Complete] and perform the required actions, task status and data will update within 1–2 hours.
Participating in other similar Gate events at the same time does not affect reward claims for this event.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the event. Prohibited conduct includes using multiple accounts to participate repeatedly, impersonating others or submitting false identity verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, coordinating to improperly obtain rewards, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the event. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
Market makers, companies, institutions, affiliates, and their sub-affiliates are not eligible to participate in this event.
To ensure fairness and impartiality, the platform reserves the right to adjust or end the event early based on actual circumstances. Thank you for your understanding.
If there is any discrepancy between a translated version and the English version, the English version prevails.
Gate reserves the right to make the final interpretation of this event.
Users in the UK and other restricted regions are unable to use all or part of the services, including participating in this event, game, or competition. For details on restricted regions, please read the User Agreement. Please note that we do not intend to solicit or market to customers in such restricted regions.

Exchange/platform: Hibt
Headline: Hibt Popular Cryptocurrency Trading Competition
Start: 2026-11-19T16:01:00Z · End: 2026-11-26T15:59:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Dear users: The Hibt Spot Hot Coin Carnival is officially open! Trade the 10 most popular spot currencies and win multiple rewards!
I. Activity Time
Event period: November 19, 2026, 16:01 — November 26, 2026, 15:59 (UTC)
II. Participating Currencies
DOGE/USDT, FIST/USDT, PI/USDT, BTW/USDT, S/USDT, WALLET/USDT, PROS/USDT, TIBBIR/USDT, SHIB/USDT, STONK/USDT
III. Activity Rules
Activity 1: Transaction Volume Ranking Competition
Rewards will be distributed based on user rankings for cumulative spot trading volume (buy + sell, converted to USDT) of 10 designated cryptocurrencies during the event period.
Ranking | Rewards (USDT)
1st place | 800 bonus + 200 real money
2nd place | 500 bonus + 150 real money
3rd place | 300 bonus + 100 real money
4th-10th place | 200 bonus + 50 real money
11th-20th place | 100 bonus + 20 real money
Activity Two: Currency Check-in Task
For every ≧100 USDT spot transaction completed by a user in a single cryptocurrency, it is considered as "checking in" for 1 cryptocurrency.
- Check in for 3 cryptocurrencies: 3 USDT spot trading discount coupon + 5 USDT event contract prediction coupon
- Check-in for 6 cryptocurrencies: 5 USDT spot trading discount coupon + 5 USDT event contract prediction coupon + 5 USDT event contract compensation coupon
- Check in for 10 cryptocurrencies (complete all cryptocurrencies): 10 USDT spot trading discount coupon + 10 USDT event contract prediction coupon + 10 USDT contract discount credit
Activity 3: First Payment Incentive for New Users
New users making their first spot trade on Hibt during the promotion period: Complete a spot trade of ≧50 USDT in any of the 10 designated cryptocurrencies and receive an additional bonus:
- 5 USDT spot discount coupon + 3 USDT event contract prediction coupon
IV. Risk Control Supplement
- Valid trading volume definition: Only buy and sell transactions of 10 specified USDT spot pairs are counted, excluding wash trades, self-trades, and wash trades by linked accounts;
- Rewards will be distributed within 3 business days after the event ends;
- HiBT reserves the right to final interpretation of this event.
